label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
@Rohan fair question da. And Sneha, no no, he’s right to ask. He and Divya trusted me with real money, I owe them a straight answer.

Yes, we let 6 of our 14 people go last Friday. The bridge round we were expecting from a Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct, when the term sheet was basically ready. After the cuts, we have around 5 months of runway.

For the record, the VC partner said “we love the energy” on the call and then disappeared for 11 days. Apparently the energy was not enough to charge his phone.

But honestly, letting people go was the worst day of my life. Worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and you all know how dramatically I handled that. We gave everyone 2 months’ pay, and we’ve already helped 4 of them get interviews. They deserved better than having to go through this, and I’m going to keep helping however I can.

Where things stand: the app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians are growing, but AC servicing is bleeding money. So we’re shutting the AC side and focusing on tie-ups with housing societies. Three societies in HSR have already signed up for pilots. I genuinely think we have a real shot there, but pilots are not a guarantee.

About your and Divya’s 3 lakh: **the money is at risk, but it isn’t gone.** You came in through the friends round in 2025 on the same terms as everyone else. I can’t honestly tell you it’s safe or promise what you’ll get back. What happens next depends on whether we can make this plan work and secure more funding before the runway runs out.

Can we get on a proper call with you and Divya this week? I’ll show you both the numbers and answer whatever you want to ask. No LinkedIn cricket-captain statements, promise.

And before this group starts planning my candlelight vigil, I’m okay. The office security uncle now asks if I want masala or plain because I’m eating Maggi there at 11 pm so often. Amma also asked last week if TCS is still hiring, so my backup options are being actively researched.

I’m coming Saturday. Pranav is buying. Rohan, sad face practice optional for now. 🍻
